title: 4chan whistleblower: a decade working on crash retrievals

tellings.quote: whistleblower reported that he'd been working on these crash retrievals for like a for a decade or whatever it was uh in the early 2000s, late 90s, and

plain: An anonymous poster on 4chan, an online message board, claimed to have spent about a decade working on crash retrievals, the recovery of crashed craft of unknown origin, in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Chris Ramsay, a YouTube creator, passes this on to Jesse Michels from the whistleblower's thread, without being sure of the exact details. If true, it would mean secret recovery work on such craft went on for years.
